title: Detailed paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hull' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fdfaf2'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e6ddc6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='inner' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#cfc4a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b8ac8c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sailL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f3ecd9'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sailR' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#efe7d2'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M4,80 Q14,75 24,80 Q34,85 44,80 Q54,75 64,80 Q74,85 84,80 Q92,76 96,79 L96,90 L4,90 Z' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <path d='M4,84 Q14,80 24,84 Q34,88 44,84 Q54,80 64,84 Q74,88 84,84 Q92,81 96,83 L96,92 L4,92 Z' fill='#29a8e0'/>

  <!-- bow sail (left) -->
  <path d='M47,38 L20,66 L47,66 Z' fill='url(#sailL)' stroke='#d8cfb6' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M47,40 L24,64' stroke='#e4dcc6' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- stern sail (right) -->
  <path d='M53,38 L80,66 L53,66 Z' fill='url(#sailR)' stroke='#d8cfb6' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M53,40 L76,64' stroke='#e4dcc6' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- inner hull opening -->
  <path d='M34,66 L66,66 L60,72 L40,72 Z' fill='url(#inner)'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M12,66 L88,66 L72,80 Q50,86 28,80 Z' fill='url(#hull)' stroke='#d8cfb6' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- hull creases -->
  <path d='M50,66 L50,83' stroke='#d8cfb6' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M31,68 Q38,74 40,79' stroke='#ddd4bd' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M69,68 Q62,74 60,79' stroke='#ddd4bd' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M16,67 Q20,69 26,70' stroke='#e2dac4' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M84,67 Q80,69 74,70' stroke='#e2dac4' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
</svg>
